units.source_text: 节日仪仗队出场的御所附近的座位都被佛教团体和观光协会占去了。

en.t: The seats near the Imperial Palace where the festival procession would appear had all been taken by Buddhist groups and the tourism association.

units.source_text: 秀男和苗子只好站在观礼席后面。

en.t: Hideo and Naeko had no choice but to stand behind the viewing seats.
